Subject: Discovery recap + next steps — VP/CTO intro to align on architecture

Hi Alicia / Diego,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and a proposed path forward: 

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference cost for patient-facing summarization, improve 95th% latency under 200ms for the mobile app, and ensure data residency controls for PHI workloads.
- Current infra: on-prem model store + cloud ingestion pipeline (briefly discussed).
- Fit: Redwood’s Dedicated or Private options should address the latency and residency asks; the runtime’s prefix caching and batching can reduce per-token cost for high-concurrency inference.

Action items / next steps we discussed:
1) Technical deep dive with Ethan (SE) to validate architecture and performance assumptions — ~60 minutes
2) Executive alignment call (VP / CTO level) to confirm timelines and procurement needs — ~30 minutes
3) Demo of a prototype inference flow and cost runway — follow-up after the technical deep dive

To keep momentum, can we get availability for the technical deep dive and an executive alignment call? Tentative windows I have are below:

- Technical deep dive (60m): Wed 6/21 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 6/22 14:00–15:00 PT
- Exec alignment (30m): Fri 6/23 09:00–09:30 PT or Mon 6/26 16:00–16:30 PT

I’m looping in Ethan on the technical slots and will bring in Logan (our VP of Solutions) for the exec alignment. I’ve attached a short demo agenda and a draft MOP (methods-of-procedure) that outlines scope and success criteria.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.docx (agenda), acmehealth-mop-v1.pdf (draft MOP)

Thanks — happy to adjust to times that work better for your team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
